_README: Fixture registry. The declaration is live and unexpired, but it names a DIFFERENT
rule than the one citing the path. Matching on the path alone would let a
declaration authored for rule A silently excuse a copy-pasted Detection line in
rule B — a widening nobody declared. The scanner therefore matches on the
(rule, path) PAIR, so this case still reds dangling-probes-binding.

.claude/test-harness/probes/deferredprob.reason: Fixture stand-in for a declaration bound to a different rule than the one whose Detection block cites the path.
.claude/test-harness/probes/deferredprob.graduation: Delete this entry in the same change that lands the suite and registers it in eval-manifest.json.
